utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Quinn’s got the word out, then. I can bring a couple of tools and check who still needs help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can bring a few things too, just tell me what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll ask around and see what’s still needed before the afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Right, it’s the driveway surface itself. I’m still checking the exact fixes, but I’ve got the list straight.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just the driveway surface, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, just the driveway surface. I’m still sorting the exact fixes, but the list is straight.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I mean the driveway surface itself. Tell me what’s still cracked or uneven, and I’ll help fix it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam. The driveway is the one with the uneven cracks, and I’ll make sure we pair each fix with the right volunteer. Also, the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, Rosa. I’ll help with the uneven cracks on the driveway Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Start at 9:00, and we’ll keep it to the drill and clamps.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, thanks. I’ll bring the drill and clamps.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, then we’re set for 9:00 with just the drill and clamps.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m still ready to help with the repair drive. Just tell me what needs doing next.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — since you’re ready, could you handle the tools list and see if we still need a truck for pickup?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing—what needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, right, the repair drive. I’ve got the time mixed up a bit, but I know Rey’s willing to help, which is a relief.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, thanks. Just send me the updated time and I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Mostly the wiring and a few loose fixtures, and the drive starts Saturday morning. I’ll probably swing by a bit late.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, that helps — I’ll tell the others it’s Saturday morning and that you’ll be there a little late.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you know when the repair drive starts, or who I should contact for the details?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right, the repair drive starts at six by the community hall. I’ll pass it along to a few neighbors and see who can help out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, that helps. I’ll pass it on.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please point me to whoever’s coordinating it so I can hand my help to the right person.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m the one helping coordinate it, and it’s mostly a drop-in repair drive. Just send folks by with whatever needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules. I’ll send people your way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard the repair drive is happening, and the details are still coming in bit by bit. I’ll pass along the next update as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Pia’s been the one pulling it together, from what I’ve heard. If you need the rundown, I can point you to her.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that quiet if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, I can cover the early start and keep things quiet.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, I’ll keep it quiet and help where needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, I can lend a hand with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, then I’ll bring the repair drive over and wait for your next instructions.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center, and I’m keeping the list ready so we can match each fix with the right volunteer.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks for the update. I’ll swing by a bit late on Sunday, and it sounds like the wiring and loose fixtures are still the main things to tackle.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Good, that helps. I’ll keep wiring and the loose fixtures at the top of the list, and I’ll make sure you’re looped in when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: What exactly needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it. I’m here if you need the list of missing parts.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just the missing parts list, and I can take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can lend a hand with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds like it’s mostly set up and you’re willing to help, which is good. I’ll pass along that the repair drive is underway and details are still coming in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll keep an ear out and help where I can once the details come through.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, then let’s keep it at 9:00 and just bring the drill and clamps.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll pass that along while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you mean the driveway itself, right? What still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, the driveway. Mostly the wiring and a couple of loose fixtures still need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, six at the community hall. I’ve got the supplies list straight, so let’s keep the repair drive organized and matched up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, I’m glad it’s organized. Who should I coordinate with for supplies, so I don’t send help to the wrong place?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Coordinate with Rosa for the supply list and me for anything still missing. I’ll keep the supplies straight so nothing gets sent to the wrong place.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can keep folks updated and bring any tools Sam still needs.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, just the driveway surface. Tell me what’s still cracked or uneven, and I’ll help fix it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll check the driveway and let you know what’s cracked or uneven.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’m telling everyone I can, so come by and bring whatever tools you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll need trucks and a few volunteers too. Can you send anyone with a pickup by the east lot?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send anyone with a pickup to the east lot and keep rallying more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It starts Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you know who’s coordinating it?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m ready to help with the repair drive. Let me know what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, great — Pia’s the one coordinating it, so I can point you her way if you want to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — point me her way, and I’ll check in with Pia about what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help if you need a quiet pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m here too, just tell me what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Just point me to the list, and I can help sort who’s doing what.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what needs repairing, and what time the drive starts on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, it’s the repair drive at the community hall, starting at six on Saturday. I’ve got the details a bit mixed, but Rey said he can help out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. Just to confirm, it’s the community hall at six on Saturday, right?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved again from Sunday at the community center to Monday at the school gym.
